tasks.label: Inspect databases before creating app DB
Inspect Senior Manager PostgreSQL databases
args: $secure = Read-Host 'Contrasena del usuario postgres (entrada oculta)' -AsSecureString; $ptr = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secure); try { $env:PGPASSWORD = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($ptr) } finally { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($ptr) }; try { & 'C:\PROGRA~1\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe' -X -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT datname AS base FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate = false ORDER BY datname;"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'No se pudo consultar pg_database.' }; $dbs = & 'C:\PROGRA~1\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe' -X -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -d postgres -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate = false ORDER BY datname;"; foreach ($db in $dbs) { $match = & 'C:\PROGRA~1\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe' -X -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -d $db -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT to_regclass('public.usuarios') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.permisos_rol') IS NOT NULL;" 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $match -eq 't') { Write-Output "SENIOR_MANAGER_SCHEMA=$db" } }; } finally { Remove-Item Env:PGPASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tasks.label: Check Senior Manager database readiness
args: SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS db_user;
SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name;

SELECT to_regclass('public.usuarios') IS NOT NULL AS has_users, to_regclass('public.permisos_rol') IS NOT NULL AS has_permissions, to_regclass('public.permission_bootstrap_state') IS NOT NULL AS has_bootstrap_marker, to_regclass('public.flyway_schema_history') IS NOT NULL AS has_flyway_history;

SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.usuarios') IS NULL THEN 'users table missing' ELSE (SELECT 'users=' || count(*)::text || ', active_admins=' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE rol = 'ADMINISTRADOR' AND activo)::text FROM usuarios) END AS account_status;
SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.permisos_rol') IS NULL THEN 'permissions table missing' ELSE (SELECT 'permission_rows=' || count(*)::text FROM permisos_rol) END AS permission_status;

tasks.label: Check database setup status
args: SELECT version, description, success FROM flyway_schema_history ORDER BY installed_rank;
SELECT count(*) AS total_users, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rol = 'ADMINISTRADOR' AND activo) AS active_admins FROM usuarios;
SELECT count(*) AS permission_rows FROM permisos_rol;
SELECT count(*) AS bootstrap_markers FROM permission_bootstrap_state;

tasks.label: Read-only database readiness check
args: SELECT version, description, success FROM flyway_schema_history ORDER BY installed_rank;
SELECT rol, activo, count(*) FROM usuarios GROUP BY rol, activo ORDER BY rol, activo;
SELECT count(*) AS permission_rows FROM permisos_rol;
SELECT count(*) AS bootstrap_markers FROM permission_bootstrap_state;

tasks.label: Apply authorized V5 V6 migrations
args: $env:JAVA_HOME="C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.20.101-hotspot"; $env:PATH="$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:PATH"; $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_JDBC_URL="jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/senior_manager_migration_dev"; $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_DB_USERNAME="postgres"; $secure=Read-Host password -AsSecureString; $ptr=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secure); try { $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_DB_PASSWORD=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($ptr) } finally { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($ptr) }; mvn -f backend/pom.xml "-Dsenior.manage.mainClass=infrastructure.migrations.ApplyMigrations" exec:java; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error "Flyway migrations failed; do not start the API yet." }

tasks.label: Start Senior Manager backend locally
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.20.101-hotspot'; $env:PATH="$($env:JAVA_HOME)\bin;$env:PATH"; $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_JDBC_URL='jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/senior_manager_migration_dev'; $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_DB_USERNAME='senior_manager_app'; $secure=Read-Host 'PostgreSQL password for senior_manager_app' -AsSecureString; $ptr=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secure); try { $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_DB_PASSWORD=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($ptr) } finally { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($ptr) }; $secretBytes=New-Object byte[] 32; [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Fill($secretBytes); $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_JWT_SECRET=[Convert]::ToBase64String($secretBytes); [Array]::Clear($secretBytes,0,$secretBytes.Length); $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_JWT_KEY_ID='local-session-key'; $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_JWT_ISSUER='senior-manager-local'; $env:SENIOR_MANAGE_JWT_AUDIENCE='senior-manager-local'; mvn -f backend/pom.xml exec:java
